results.question: What is the total order revenue by customer country?

raw.sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM ecommerce.customers c JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

guarded.sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM ecommerce.customers c JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

ontology.sql:
SELECT
  c.country,
  ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM ecommerce.customers AS c
JOIN ecommerce.orders AS o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
  c.country
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC

ontology_guarded.sql:
SELECT
  c.country,
  ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM ecommerce.customers AS c
JOIN ecommerce.orders AS o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
  c.country
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC

results.question: What is the average review rating for each product category?

raw.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS average_rating FROM ecommerce.reviews r JOIN ecommerce.order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN ecommerce.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

guarded.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS average_rating FROM ecommerce.reviews r JOIN ecommerce.order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN ecommerce.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

ontology.sql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS average_rating
FROM ecommerce.products AS p
JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS oi
  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN ecommerce.reviews AS r
  ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY
  p.category

ontology_guarded.sql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS average_rating
FROM ecommerce.products AS p
JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS oi
  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN ecommerce.reviews AS r
  ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY
  p.category
